title: Senior Systems Engineer, Space Imaging
tags: Mission Systems : Imaging Engineering : Imaging - System Engineering,Integration and Test
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Space Imaging team is seeking a Systems Engineer to join our team. The Imaging Space team is responsible for system architecture definition, trade analyses, and modeling/validating system performance for spaceborne EO/IR systems.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining active EO/IR system architectures. You will perform radiometric performance modeling as well as laboratory, ground, and flight testing. To predict real-world performance, you will also model atmospheric and environmental effects for land, sea, and air targets. You will leverage your analyses to inform system-level architectural trades. As needed, you will also lead small teams of engineers from concept ideation through system definition and development.

You should have a track record of successfully working on fast-paced, highly technical, interdisciplinary teams. Proficiency in analytical toolchains or languages (e.g., MATLAB, Python) is required. Experience with industry standard EO/IR modeling software packages (e.g. MODTRAN, SPIRITS, AFSIM) is a plus. Prior experience working with space sensors and systems is highly desirable.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Define system architectures via detailed trade studies and analyses.

• Adapt or derive physics-based models of sensor system performance and derive requirements based on those models.

• Take ownership over the development of prototype sensor systems in a lab environment.

• Support both laboratory-based and field-based experiments and demonstrations.

• Engage technically with the hardware, software, and mission teams to define, integrate, and deliver high performance systems to our customers.

• Validate models against laboratory and real-world data.

• Coordinate and communicate with both external & internal stakeholders with varying degrees of technical background.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Model development and validation in one or more domains relevant to remote sensing

• Ability to decompose complex systems into functional parts, with clearly defined interfaces and requirements for each.

• Experience in system design and development from initial concept through test and delivery to customer.

• Strong laboratory skills (rapid prototyping, design of experiments) and familiarity with opto-electrical test and measurement equipment.

• Willingness to travel to test sites, as needed.

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of current and next-generation advanced sensing systems and platforms

• Active and passive sensing domain experience (e.g., LiDAR, EO/IR, Radar)

• Experience with laser systems, including opto-mechanical scanning and beam steering techniques.

• Knowledge of electro-mechanical control systems, including their performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Experience with LiDAR/Radar signal processing techniques, and knowledge of their implementation on real-time embedded platforms (FPGA, MCU, etc.).

• Experience with signature and/or scenario modeling/software packages (MODTRAN, SPIRITS, AFSIM).

• Space domain experience (architecting sensors for operation in space environments)

description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Location: Lawrenceville/Loganville/Hoschton/Peachtree Corners, GA

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $90,000-$120,000/year

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Pediatric Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) to join our team. In this role, you will evaluate and treat children with a wide range of speech, language, and feeding/swallowing needs, working closely with families to guide them in understanding their child's areas of need and strengths. A central part of this position is helping families support their child's intervention and carryover of skills at home, at school, and in the community, ensuring progress made in session translates into everyday life.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct comprehensive speech, language, articulation, fluency, voice, and feeding/swallowing evaluations for pediatric clients

• Develop individualized treatment plans with measurable goals based on assessment findings and each child's developmental level

• Provide direct, evidence-based therapy for a caseload of pediatric clients with diverse communication and feeding disorders

• Guide families in understanding their child's areas of need and strengths, translating clinical findings into clear, actionable information

• Partner with parents and caregivers to support carryover of skills and strategies at home, at school, and in the community

• Coordinate and communicate with teachers, pediatricians, occupational and physical therapists, and other providers involved in the child's care

• Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation, including evaluation reports, SOAP notes, progress notes, and insurance-required paperwork

• Track client progress toward goals on an ongoing basis and adjust treatment plans as needed

• Participate in team meetings, case conferences, and school-based meetings (e.g., IEP/IFSP) as needed

• Educate parents and caregivers on home exercise programs, strategies, and tools to reinforce therapy outside of sessions

• Stay current with best practices, research, and continuing education in pediatric speech-language pathology

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology from a program accredited by the Council on Academic Accreditation (CAA)

• Active Georgia state license in Speech-Language Pathology (or eligibility to obtain), and ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP)

• Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience working with pediatric clients across a range of speech, language, and feeding/swallowing disorders

• Strong understanding of child development and evidence-based assessment and treatment approaches for pediatric communication and feeding disorders

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build rapport with children and explain clinical concepts clearly and empathetically to parents and caregivers

• Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and to coordinate treatment carryover across home, school, and community settings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supervising Clinical Fellows (CFs) or graduate student clinicians

• Specialized training or certification (e.g., PROMPT, feeding and swallowing certifications, AAC)

• Bilingual or multilingual skills

• Prior experience in a private practice or pediatric outpatient setting

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

• Electronic health record / practice management systems (e.g., SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, WebPT, or similar)

• Standardized assessment tools (e.g., CELF, PLS-5, GFTA, or comparable pediatric speech/language batteries)

title: Remote Clinical Validation Reviewer (RN)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides support for inpatient and outpatient clinical claim review activities. Verifies that coded diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, and corresponding reimbursement methodologies accurately reflect the member's documented clinical condition, services rendered, and billed charges. Assesses medical records for clinical accuracy, acuity alignment, and documentation integrity. Identifies inconsistencies that impact reimbursement such as unsupported diagnoses, incorrect procedure coding, or inaccurate revenue code assignment and determines whether billed services meet coding and billing guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements. Contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.
Essential Job Duties

• Reviews inpatient and/or outpatient claims to ensure diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, itemized charges, and Diagnostic Related Groups (DRG) assignments accurately reflect the documented clinical condition and services provided.
• Integrates ICD‑10 coding principles, DRG methodologies, revenue code logic, and evidence‑based clinical guidelines when reviewing claims for accuracy, appropriateness, and alignment with documentation.
• Performs DRG validation reviews by verifying principal and secondary diagnoses, complications/comorbidities, procedure coding, severity level, and correct grouping logic.
• Conducts itemized bill reviews to confirm that charges are supported by clinical documentation, compliant with billing standards, and appropriate for the level of care delivered; identifies unsupported, inaccurate, or inappropriate coding or billing elements such as unsubstantiated diagnoses, incorrect procedures, or incorrect revenue code usage.
• Develops clear, evidence‑based written rationales supporting diagnosis, procedure, revenue code, or DRG recommendations and determinations.
• Substantiates all review outcomes using clinical indicators, documentation, coding guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements.
• Performs review work independently, applying sound clinical judgment and specialized expertise to evaluate complex claim scenarios.
• Applies applicable federal/state regulations, official coding guidelines, payer policies, and Molina payment integrity standards during all reviews.
• Ensures compliance with DRG and itemized bill review criteria, clinical validation rules, and reimbursement methodologies.
• Collaborates with coding, payment integrity analytics, SIU, and physician advisors to clarify complex clinical documentation, coding discrepancies, or reimbursement determinations.
• Provides subject matter expertise on DRG validation, revenue code accuracy, itemized bill review, and documentation integrity to internal partners as needed.
• Meets or exceeds established productivity goals set by payment integrity leadership for clinical validation and claim review activities.
• Achieves the required accuracy and quality standards for review, diagnosis/procedure validation, and/or itemized bill reviews.
• Participates in quality checks, calibration sessions, and ongoing training to maintain consistency and strengthen review competency.
• Completes special projects and additional review assignments as delegated by leadership. Identifies patterns and trends in documentation, coding, or billing that may require internal escalation, provider education, or process improvement.
• Supports continuous improvement efforts by contributing insights that enhance review processes, criteria application, and workflow efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of experience in inpatient payment integrity medical claim review including DRG validation or itemized bill review, and experience working with ICD-10, MS-DRG, AP-DRG and APR-DRG, CPT, HCPCS, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

• Advanced in DRG methodologies.

title: Manager, Talent Account Management
description:
Overview
Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth
The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close. The TAMs own the hiring manager relationship and the candidate experience once a candidate enters an active process. This Manager makes sure that work is focused on the right roles, delivered to a consistent standard, and measured in a way the business can trust.
The role is accountable for delivery outcomes, reporting, customer satisfaction and escalations. It works from the priority order set jointly with the Capacity Planning Manager, so that TAM time goes to the roles that matter most to i2G's contracts and markets. It operates on Kastle Systems' talent platforms (iCIMS, LinkedIn and Indeed) and draws its candidate supply from Kastle's Sourcing team.
This is a leadership and delivery role, not a sourcing role and not a demand-planning role. It does not own the demand forecast, which sits with the Capacity Planning Manager. It does not own top-of-funnel sourcing, which sits with Kastle's Sourcing team. It owns what happens between those two: turning qualified leads into hires, and doing it well.
Reporting and working relationships

•
Chief Operating Officer, i2G (direct). Sets business priorities for the team, evaluates performance and is the escalation point for delivery and resourcing issues.

•
Senior Director, Talent Acquisition, Kastle Systems (indirect). Sets recruiting process standards, platform usage and compliance expectations, and partners on team practices and reporting.

•
Capacity Planning Manager, i2G (peer). Owns the labor demand forecast and the rolling requisition priority order. The two roles agree together where TAM effort goes each month.

•
Kastle Sourcing team (upstream partner). Supplies sourced and inbound candidates to the TAMs. This Manager owns the quality feedback loop back to Sourcing.

•
i2G hiring managers and branch leadership (customers). The people the TAMs serve. This Manager is the senior point of contact for their satisfaction and their escalations.

Responsibilities
Key responsibilities
1. Team leadership and coaching

• Lead, coach and develop three Talent Account Managers. Set clear expectations, run regular one-to-ones and case reviews, and give direct performance feedback.

• Assign requisition portfolios to TAMs based on priority, complexity, market and workload, and rebalance as demand shifts.

• Set and audit the standard for the TAM role: intake quality, screening rigor, submittal quality, interview coordination, feedback turnaround, offer preparation and close.

• Coach TAMs on running difficult conversations with hiring managers, including pushing back on unrealistic requirements or slow decisions.

• Hire, onboard and backfill TAMs as needed, and maintain a development path for the team.

2. Prioritization and alignment with capacity planning

• Work with the Capacity Planning Manager as the single point of alignment between operations demand and TAM delivery.

• Run the team from the rolling 90-day requisition forecast and its agreed priority order. Confirm each month which roles get TAM focus first.

• Make sure TAM effort follows priority, not volume of requests or the loudest hiring manager. Flag when priorities conflict or when demand exceeds what the team can deliver.

• Take part in the monthly talent acquisition and operations review with data, recommendations and follow-through on decisions.

• Raise early warning when a priority role is at risk, including the revenue or delivery consequence, so trade-offs are made with full information.

3. Hiring manager partnership and customer satisfaction

• Own the operating relationship with i2G hiring managers and branch leadership at the leadership level, and hold the TAMs to a consistent service standard.

• Set and enforce an intake standard so every requisition has a clear profile, priority, compensation range and interview plan befo

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Capacity Planning
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER OF CAPACITY PLANNING, YOU WILL:

- Own the capacity planning program end-to-end - from demand forecasting and resource modeling to procurement coordination and delivery tracking across Snowflake's multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Drive cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, and Cloud Provider teams to ensure capacity meets projected growth, seasonal demand spikes, and new product launches

- Build and improve forecasting models and frameworks that translate business growth signals, customer onboarding patterns, and workload trends into actionable infrastructure capacity plans

- Establish governance and review cadences - own weekly/monthly capacity reviews with engineering leadership, surface risks and tradeoffs, and drive decisions on resource allocation and prioritization

- Identify and mitigate capacity risks proactively - monitor utilization trends, flag bottlenecks, single points of failure, and lead constraint resolution before they become customer-impacting

- Partner closely with engineering teams to understand workload characteristics, architecture changes, and new feature launches that affect capacity requirements

- Drive efficiency and optimization programs - identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve utilization, and right-size infrastructure spend without compromising performance or availability

- Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity health, spend trajectory, and delivery timelines

- Influence infrastructure strategy by providing data-driven recommendations on cloud provider mix, reserved vs. on-demand strategy, and long-term capacity investments

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Required:

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, infrastructure planning, capacity management, or a related discipline at a cloud-scale technology company

- Demonstrated experience managing programs across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP)

- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, networking, containerization, and resource orchestration

- Experience with demand forecasting, resource modeling, and data-driven decision-making at scale

- Proven ability to drive cross-functional programs spanning engineering, finance, and operations with VP/Director-level stakeholders

- Excellent communication skills - ability to synthesize complex technical and financial data into clear executive-ready narratives

- Strong program management fundamentals: dependency tracking, risk management, milestone governance, and stakeholder alignment

Preferred:

- Experience with infrastructure capacity planning at hyperscale (10K+ node deployments or equivalent)

- Familiarity with cloud cost management and FinOps principles

- Experience with data platforms, data warehousing, or database infrastructure

- Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent)

- Background in building or improving automated capacity planning systems and tooling

- Experience operating in a fast-growth, high-ambiguity environment where priorities shift quickly

SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- Get It Done - You thrive

description:

This role is the resident expert in refrigeration systems.

You have...

• 4-6 years of experience with refrigeration repair and maintenance in an industrial setting, 

• Advanced understanding of rack system refrigeration and associated equipment.

• Experience with repair and maintenance of glycol systems, heat exchangers, HVAC, and water chiller systems.

• Experience with electrical systems including single and three phase motor systems, power distribution, and low voltage controls with the ability to troubleshoot to the component level.

• Current Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Section 608 certification.

• All necessary regulatory licenses required by local municipalities to work in the field of industrial refrigeration.

• Ability to demonstrate excellent work habits in line with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s).

• Ability to conform to all OSHA, PSM, HAZMAT, and HelloFresh safety programs and regulations.

• Ability to demonstrate understanding of proper handling and recycling procedures for chlorofluorocarbon (CFC), hydrochlorofluorocarbon (HCFC), Hydrofluro-Olefins (HFO), CO2, and other industry standard refrigerant types.

• Ability to safely replace mechanical and electrical components including motors, motor starters, switches, solenoids, pumps, refrigeration valves, compressors, and auxiliary refrigeration equipment.

• Experience working with a wide range of networked refrigeration controls platforms.

• Ability to withstand walking, lifting, bending, stooping, climbing ladders, walking on roofs, and working in confined spaces.

• Basic computer skills.

• Ability to read and understand drawings,

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Implicit Signals
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team builds classification and evaluation systems that give post-training and research teams fast, reliable feedback on model behavior. We combine machine learning and production engineering to make these capabilities accurate, efficient, and useful at scale, helping researchers assess changes and improve models and products.

We work closely with research teams to develop useful measurements and make them practical to run. Our work spans classifier development, rigorous evaluation, and efficient production inference, with ownership from initial experimentation through deployment and continued improvement.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a machine learning engineer to develop new classification and evaluation capabilities and bring them into production. You’ll help turn open-ended questions about model behavior into well-defined ML problems, build methods that address them, and establish how reliably those methods work.

This role combines traditional machine learning, model evaluation, and real-time engineering. You’ll own classifiers throughout their lifecycle, including supervised fine-tuning, distillation, evaluation, deployment, and production inference. You’ll work closely with researchers to identify valuable problems and with software engineers to make promising approaches useful at scale.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build, deploy, and operate production classification and evaluation systems that provide useful feedback to post-training and research teams.

- Optimize production inference, including model serving, batching, caching, throughput, latency, compute utilization, and cost.

- Train and optimize classifiers using supervised fine-tuning and distillation, validating quality and efficiency before deployment.

- Own the reliability and observability of deployed classifiers, diagnose production issues, and improve their performance over time.

- Design rigorous evaluations that assess accuracy, calibration, generalization, and potential measurement bias while guiding production tradeoffs.

- Partner with software engineers to integrate models into reliable execution systems and support safe rollouts.

- Build reusable engineering tools that make classifier training, evaluation, deployment, and iteration faster and more repeatable.

- Work with post-training researchers and data scientists to translate their needs into modeling objectives, evaluation criteria, and production requirements.

YOUR BACKGROUND MIGHT LOOK SOMETHING LIKE

- Experience taking ML projects from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment.

- Strong foundations in supervised learning, statistics, and experimental design.

- Practical experience evaluating models, investigating systematic errors, and working with imperfect labels.

- Strong software engineering skills and the ability to build maintainable production ML systems.

- Experience reasoning about inference performance and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and compute cost.

- The ability to combine careful scientific judgment with a practical approach to shipping and operating software.

- Comfort working closely with researchers and engineers on open-ended problems.

- Fluency in using AI agents to move quickly across multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience with model distillation, representation learning, calibration, or efficient inference is a plus.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Winter 2027)
description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

• Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)

• When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)

• Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

• Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

• Train, fine-tune and distill draft models, and design rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - CoreMusic
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. We turn research breakthroughs into APIs and creative tools, from the backend systems that bring in new models to the interfaces creators use inside ElevenCreative. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress.

You’ll join as a Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ll work with research and research engineering to bring model improvements into production, and build and run the APIs behind them. You’ll also sync with go-to-market to decide which features, including bespoke enterprise ones, get built next. Occasionally you’ll join customer calls when a customer wants someone technical.

Engineers act as PMs. You’ll be handed ambiguous goals and expected to break them down. That means working through the legal questions, choosing the engineering approach, and planning the launch with growth. Models set the limits, so you’ll design systems that let a better model be swapped in later. Engineering is often only half the job.

Requirements

- A strong Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ve built and shipped production APIs and backend systems.

- A product decomposition mindset. You’ve taken a vague goal, weighed trade-offs and shipped without analysis

title: Solutions Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

We’re hiring a Solutions Strategy & Operations Manager to help build the operating system for our Customer Success and Solutions teams. This role is critical to building our business with rigor and pace, helping us scale customer value fast.

You’ll begin as a generalist supporting our Solutions Architect, Field Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering functions, with the path to own a specific business unit end-to-end as we grow and scale. These teams are technical and experienced, and we’re looking for a strong strategy & ops partner who can collaborate and help us scale their impact.

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

About the role

There are early foundations in place, but much of the long-term system still needs to be built - from maturing key metrics that matter, the cadences that drive decisions, the playbooks that scale. This is a rare chance to build that system from the ground up and shape how a fast-growing, high-stakes function runs for years to come.

This person will be a strategic thought partner and hands-on operator who is equally comfortable thinking big-picture with senior leadership and getting into the weeds to build the systems, models, and processes that let the org run on real data. They'll work cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM, and Finance to bring ideas to life quickly and iterate as the business evolves.

What you’ll do

- Establish key metrics and compensation models

- Evaluate performance of the business, drivers and trends, and guide targeted action plans

- Build, refine and optimize headcount and capacity models to ensure we make the right investments

- Build, refine and optimize segmentation and coverage modeling to ensure we deliver the right service model that ultimately leads to revenue growth

- Build and operationalize frameworks such as health signals, customer maturity models and corresponding playbooks that drive usage and growth

- Build and operationalize dashboards that surface the right KPIs and insights at the right time to drive action across all levels of the organization

- Build and operationalize an end-to-end operating cadence for the leadership team to support fast, informed decision-making

- Serve as a trusted advisor to the leadership team; You can think big picture and also lean in to figure out how to get things done iteratively

- Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders in RevOps, Go to Market, Finance and more to bring concepts to life rapidly, and iterate and evolve together

- Incorporate a global mindset into your work, taking into account local nuances and input and ensuring global plans stick regionally

You may be a fit if

- Experience in Sales or Customer Strategy and Operations

- Experience with pre-sales (e.g. sales engineering), direct sales and technical services teams

- Builder mindset -

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. ABOUT THE TEAM

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

You’ll translate complex products into clear business value for SME customers. You will also represent Airwallex at relevant industry events and engage with technology partners that complement our product suite.

We operate in a hybrid work environment, requiring presence in the office at least three days per week.

 

This role is based in Austin.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Drive the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing deals, including ramping and early customer success.

- Develop deep product expertise in Airwallex’s platform and technical solutions, particularly for payments acceptance, cross-border payments, billing or spend management, to effectively serve SME and Growth customers across verticals such as ecommerce, SaaS, technology, professional services, etc.

- Collaborate with legal, finance, and strategy teams to negotiate and execute partnership agreements and commercial contracts.

title: Product Designer
description:
ABOUT US

We’re building the next generation of the TV operating system, reimagining the experience at the intersection of television, streaming, and how people discover and search.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Designer who thinks in systems, questions assumptions, and can solve problems that don’t have an established answer.

This is a hands-on role spanning product thinking, interaction design, and visual design. You’ll help define the structure and behavior of our TV operating system, where AI is woven throughout the experience, taking ideas from early concepts and user flows through prototypes, polished interfaces, and implementation.

You should be as comfortable thinking about the big picture as you are getting deep into the details. One day, you might define how a new product experience should work; the next, you might prototype an interaction, refine elements of our design system, or test a concept with users.

You’ll report to our Head of Design and collaborate closely with the founder, engineers, and marketing team. Beyond making excellent work, you’ll help define what great design looks like and contribute to a culture where design is central to how we build.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own product design from early exploration and user flows through interaction design, prototyping, final UI, and implementation support

- Help define the right problems to solve, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints

- Shape core experiences across our TV operating system

- Design for the realities of TV, with clear hierarchy, readable interfaces, and thoughtful voice first remote navigation and focus states

- Build interactive prototypes to explore product behavior, communicate ideas, and test assumptions before development

- Use research, usability testing, product data, and feedback to inform decisions and improve experiences

- Evolve our design system, creating reusable components and patterns that help the team move quickly without lowering the bar

- Partner closely with engineers throughout development, working through edge cases and ensuring the shipped experience reflects the design intent

- Help shape our emerging design culture, standards, and creative point of view

YOU

- 5+ years of experience

- Have a portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, visual craft, and thoughtful interaction design

- Have experience designing and shipping products, at a startup, agency, or similarly fast-moving environment

- Can turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear, intuitive experiences

- Have a strong command of typography, composition, color, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Think beyond individual screens to consider complete journeys, interaction patterns, accessibility, and edge cases

- Are proficient in Figma and comfortable working with tokens, components, design systems

- Have strong instincts but welcome feedback, evidence, and better ideas

- Are autonomous and comfortable making progress when the path is not fully defined

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience designing for TV, streaming, connected devices, or remote-based interfaces

- Experience designing conversational, voice-driven, or AI-powered product experiences

- Strong motion design skills and an understanding of how animation can clarify product behavior and create delight

- Experience building a product or design system from an early stage

- Familiarity with front-end development or code-based prototyping

- An interest in exploring new creative tools and workflows, including AI, while maintaining a high standard of original craft

description:
Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern.

Unsere Technologie

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung.

Kurz gesagt, wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren.

- Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind.

- Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung.

- Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln.

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab.

- Bei der Einführung neuer Produkte unterstützt du tatkräftig, indem du Materialien beschaffst, die den neuen Prozessanforderungen und Skalierungszielen gerecht werden.

- Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele.

The role
We’re hiring a senior writer to produce website and marketing content for our clients, with a focus on complex B2B and enterprise technology. This means product pages, solution pages, industry pages and educational content for companies whose buyers range from the people using the software every day to the executives signing off on it.
We use Claude for a lot of the heavy lifting in content production. You’ll use it to get to a strong first draft fast, then do the work that makes the content good: checking every claim, sharpening the language, protecting what the page needs to rank, and making sure the reader feels understood instead of talked at.

This is a part-time role for 10-20 hours/week. Our ideal candidate has working hours between 10 am and 6 pm EST Monday-Friday.
What you’ll do

• Write and edit high volumes of website content across reusable page templates, working in sprints with clear weekly deliverables

• Use Claude and our established content workflows to produce first drafts, then edit them into publishable copy

• Turn technical products into plain language that a buyer can understand, without losing accuracy

• Tailor messaging by audience: company size (enterprise, mid-market, small business) and buyer role (daily user, budget owner, executive)

• Fact-check product and capability claims against source material and subject-matter experts, and flag anything that can’t be verified

• Optimize content for search and AI answer engines using Clearscope, keyword targets and AEO structure (direct answers, FAQs, scannable formatting)

• Work with client product marketers and other subject-matter experts, merge their feedback into our structure, and make the case for what should stay and why

• Present editorial decisions, explaining what changed and why it’s better

• Partner with designers by delivering headlines and structure early so design and content move in parallel

What you bring

• 5+ years of B2B content writing, ideally for enterprise software, SaaS or another technical category

• Strong editing instincts. You can tell when a confident draft is wrong, vague or generic, and you know how to fix it

• Experience writing with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as part of your production process, and a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t

• Working knowledge of SEO and AEO: keyword targeting, search intent and structuring content for both people and AI search

• Comfort learning a complex product or industry quickly, through documentation, demos and interviews

• The confidence to push back on a client rewrite, and the judgment to know when to give ground

• Plain, direct writing. No jargon, no filler, no agency-speak

• Experience managing multiple projects and hitting deadlines on a sprint schedule

Nice to have

• Background in supply chain, logistics, fintech, legal tech or another operationally complex industry

• Experience with Clearscope, Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools

• Experience writing for global audiences or content that will be translated

• Experience with Asana, Figma and Google Workspace

• A journalism or technical writing background

What this role isn’t
This is a writing and editing role. You’ll use Claude every day, but you won’t be responsible for building or maintaining the AI tools and workflows behind it. That work is owned separately so you can focus on the content.
